title: Remove Internet Identity requirement and run app in anonymous mode

requirements.text: Remove all Internet Identity-gated signup/login flows so the core app pages can be used without any signup or login. Specifically, anonymous users must be able to access and use the main routes (ReportEntryPage, ReportHistoryPage, ReportDetailPage) without being redirected to or blocked by LoginScreen, ProfileSetup, or SignupPendingAccessScreen.

quotes: why still internet identity is required for signup or login. I do not want this function

acceptanceCriteria: When opening the app in a fresh browser (no stored Internet Identity session), navigating to / renders the report entry UI (not a login/signup screen).
/history and /report/:reportId render without requiring Internet Identity.
No UI flow forces the user to authenticate via Internet Identity in order to create/view reports.
No user-facing text on these anonymous flows says or implies that signing in/signing up is required.

requirements.text: Update the app header/navigation to behave correctly in anonymous mode by hiding identity-dependent UI. Specifically: do not show the user name block when no profile is available; hide/remove the "Sign Out" action for anonymous users; keep admin navigation hidden unless admin status is positively confirmed, and ensure anonymous users never see admin navigation.

quotes: I do not want this function

acceptanceCriteria: In anonymous mode, the header does not show a user name/username block.
In anonymous mode, the header does not show a "Sign Out" button/menu item.
The "Users" (admin) navigation is not visible unless admin status is positively confirmed; it is never visible for anonymous users.

requirements.text: Ensure admin-only routes remain protected from anonymous access (e.g., /admin/users). Anonymous users attempting to access admin routes must see an access denied screen and must not be prompted to log in with Internet Identity.

quotes: why still internet identity is required for signup or login. I do not want this function

acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /admin/users while anonymous shows an access denied UI (not an Internet Identity login prompt).
Admin routes remain accessible only when the existing admin-check logic positively confirms admin status.

requirements.text: Apply a coherent, consistent visual theme across the updated anonymous-mode screens and navigation (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) aligned with an industrial/service-reporting app aesthetic, avoiding blue/purple as primary brand colors.

quotes: I do not want this function

acceptanceCriteria: Anonymous-mode pages and navigation look visually consistent (shared typography, spacing, and component styling).
Primary theme does not use blue/purple as the main brand colors.

constraints: Do not edit files in frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and frontend/src/components/ui.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if a stable-state upgrade is required.
nonGoals: Implementing a custom username/password authentication system to replace Internet Identity.
Adding third-party authentication providers or external databases.
Changing report storage semantics beyond what is required to remove Internet Identity-gated access.
